frequency_question: How often do announced major vehicle or heavy industry manufacturing schemes get formally notified and implemented with specific financial mechanisms (subsidies/guarantees) within the allotted policy windows?
membership_rule: Members are major industrial promotion or sector-specific manufacturing financing schemes announced by Union Ministries in India, evaluated on whether formal gazette notification/launch matching criteria occurs within the deadline. Excludes minor scheme modifications or general budget announcements without distinct implementation frameworks.
